title: Execution Proposal Rejection
description: execution-proposal-rejection/v2: the receiver refusing a proposed execution. A proposal is never partly refused; the pledger answers with a new proposal.

proposalId.description: The proposal refused. The event also references the proposal event itself.

reason.description: Why the proposal was refused, for the pledger to correct.

field.description: The proposal field the objection is about, such as terms.cash.

details.description: Objections per field, when the receiver's check produced them.
